name: Srinagar
registryBasis: Jammu and Kashmir Revenue Department exposes a public land-records application shell, and DILRMP publishes Srinagar district cadastral-map digitization/geo-reference status. The Srinagar Development Authority publishes a 2035 land-use map, not parcel geometry. Publicly indexed ArcGIS MapServer parcel layers were metadata-inspected: their parcel-layer extents are in the Jammu area and miss the WUP Srinagar point; their schemas include owner/contact and property/address fields. No feature query was sent.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The public JK Revenue page loads a secure land-records application shell; its static client contains authentication/OTP/captcha routes and no anonymous vector schema was established. The Srinagar Development Authority map is a static land-use plan. ArcGIS parcel-layer metadata on the indexed Jammu/Srinagar services shows that the feature layer extents do not cover the WUP target point; the broader layer schema also includes owner/contact and address identifiers, so no feature request was issued.
scopeLimits: Srinagar district map-digitization status and a city 2035 planning map are documented. The accessed district map is administrative; the 2035 PDF is a land-use plan. The discovered parcel-feature layers are outside the target point extent and expose personal fields in metadata, so they were not queried. No citywide parcel completeness is inferred.

officialSources.observation: Government of India DILRMP provides tehsil-level map-digitization status for District Srinagar.
Jammu and Kashmir Revenue Department public land-record app shell; the initial page is not a parcel map and static client lists authentication endpoints.
Srinagar Development Authority identifies itself as a Government of J&K body and links to Master Plan 2035, Land Use Map and Online Building Permission.
SDA land-use map page links a static 2035 land-use PDF, not a parcel feature dataset.
